mentions.name: Ok Things
mentions.description: A phone app that handles household management on autopilot: it tracks food and expiration dates, shopping, chores, and sends periodic notifications to review lists, helping users waste less food and actually do their chores instead of procrastinating.
mentions.problem: People waste money on food that spoils and time on procrastination when managing household tasks
mentions.audience: Unmotivated people who procrastinate and waste money (e.g., wasted food) and time on household management
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on an app that helps me (and other people) do household management on autopilot. It helps me manage things, food, expiration dates, shopping, chores, and I get notified periodically to review my lists. I waste way less food and I actually do my chores instead of procrastinating. https://okthings.app
